name: Ash Lichen
description: A pale lichen that grows on ash and concrete and glows faintly at dusk.
role: The only life that thrives in the Ash Wastes; it marks cooler, safer ground.

artBrief.detail: Crusty rosettes with a faint yellow-green glow at their centers.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Bone white and pale yellow-green on grey.
